purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: White House COVID.gov Reactivation — July 2026
question: What changed on the COVID.gov surface and in the surrounding official hearing and release sequence on July 29, and what did not change?
bluf: The July 29 White House post reactivated an existing and later-extended COVID.gov narrative during the Fauci hearing. It did not itself publish a new study, assessment, declassification, legal instrument or adjudication.
entities: Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
